svg.title: Speculative decoding
svg.desc: Standalone approval draft: a spaced proposal stage with a trained draft, explicit next-token prediction rows in the causal visibility matrix, the preserved first-mismatch acceptance example, and a planned training-to-deployment flow for draft weights with a frozen target. No measured training or speed result is asserted.
svg.text: Speculative decoding: propose a block, verify it, commit the valid prefix
A trained draft proposes tokens; the fixed target checks them before they enter the output
Draft first; verify the block with the target. Accepted tokens extend the committed context.
Predict four new tokens, plus a possible bonus.
Colored cells = visible keys, not attention scores.
Accept / reject with greedy target output
Keep A, B; use target correction X at the first mismatch.
Drop C and dependent D. If all match, a bonus token is possible.
Symbolic token example. The trained draft proposes; only target-verified output enters the existing agent/tool loop.
